releases.title: First release
notes: A Halloween pumpkin hunt with 200 placed pumpkins across Los Santos and Blaine County.
A hand-drawn hunter's journal with progress, milestones, a leaderboard and settings.
Jumpscares players can turn off, or keep without the flashing effects.
Admin commands to add, remove and export spots in game.
Qbox, QBCore, ESX or standalone, in 15 languages.
